questions.question: Walk me through how you have prepared balance-sheet reconciliations and investigated differences in general-ledger activity during a monthly close.

This role requires standard costing, cost centers, profit centers, and project-based costing in a manufacturing ERP. What experience or coursework has prepared you to work with these accounting methods?
Describe a time you identified a billing, pricing, or accounting variance. How did you research the issue, resolve it, and prevent it from recurring?
What monthly, quarterly, or year-end close responsibilities have you handled, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting documentation?
How have you used Excel, Hyperion, or Oracle to analyze financial data, prepare reports, or support budgeting and variance analysis?
In a manufacturing environment, how would you investigate an unfavorable cost variance in partnership with Production and Engineering?
Describe an accounting process you improved. What problem did you identify, what changes did you make, and what was the result?
What has been your involvement in year-end audits, and how did you prepare schedules, support documentation, and responses for auditors?
How would you approach maintaining accurate inventory and accounting records when supporting a physical inventory count and month-end close?
This position requires reporting under local GAAP and IFRS or US GAAP. What GAAP-based reporting and compliance work have you performed, and how did you ensure the accuracy of financial records?
